info.title: ASL ORIGINALS API
info.description: One API for asl-web, asl-mobile (`/api/v1/store`) and asl-admin (`/api/v1/admin`). Money is integer kobo. Errors: `{ error: { code, message, details, requestId } }`.

post.description:
One active reservation per customer per drop (`ALREADY_RESERVED`); a full allocation answers `OUT_OF_STOCK`. Calling again while the deposit is unpaid opens a new payment for the same reservation.

**Requires** `Idempotency-Key` header.
